stamp: NEWS HUB. Headlines only. Not a ticket. DO NOT BUY from a headline.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
items.sum: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

items.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
items.sum: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From Ultrasound Money, Says ETH Value Is Stability
items.sum: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH value comes from stability, not fee burns.

items.title: Tom Lees Bitmine Adds 20M in Ethereum
items.sum: The firms stash reached 6.07 million ETH, 4.97 percent of supply.

items.title: Binance hack launderers mint homemade memecoins to move stolen funds
items.sum: Elliptic says the extra swaps slow investigators down, but the stolen funds remain traceable onchain.

items.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from 6.3 billion Binance hack
items.sum: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder funds from the Binance hack.

items.title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
items.sum: Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens.

items.title: Avalanches AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
items.sum: AVAX token rose as much as 10 percent after the NYSE selected its blockchain.

items.title: Strategy Buys 82M in Bitcoin, Buys Back 188M of STRC
items.sum: The Bitcoin treasury firm sold MSTR stock to fund the moves.

items.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks
items.sum: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange planned blockchain stock market.
